questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or text. This sign warns you that traffic will be merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to immediate road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see it at intersections where U-turns are unsafe due to traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Cross only after you confirm no trains are coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or text. This sign tells you a divided roadway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that vehicles will be merging into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to remind drivers to slow down, be careful, and look for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or text. This sign warns you of an upcoming winding road. Reduce your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or text. This sign alerts you to a pedestrian crossing ahead. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and wait until they have completely crossed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road direction is changing or the road is getting narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look and listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the clearance height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, the height is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services like rest areas, food, gas, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road splits ahead and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to prepare for traffic merging from the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red, eight-sided sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. It prohibits right turns where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road will meet another road ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.
